tools.detail: ClickBank is a global marketplace for digital products and affiliate marketing. It offers a platform where sellers can list their digital products and affiliates can promote them to earn commissions. Key features include a wide range of digital products, customizable commission structures, and detailed sales tracking. It is ideal for both product creators looking to expand their sales channels and affiliates seeking diverse opportunities. Pros include a large product selection and robust tracking tools. Limitations may include a higher transaction fee and limited customer support options.
